programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not target:
        return out
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, c in target), max(r for r, c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)

    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] not in (background, 0)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in source), max(r for r, c in source)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    for r in range(tr1 - tr0 + 1):
        for c in range(tc1 - tc0 + 1):
            out[tr0 + r][tc0 + c] = grid[sr0 + r][sc1 - c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(code)
